sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.22730/2024, second application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C. (under Section 430 (1) of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023) for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant - Shera @ Umashankar Mehtar.

This appeal is filed by the appellants being aggrieved of the judgment dated 25.11.2022, passed in S.C. No.45/2021 by learned Presiding Judge, Special Court (POCSO) Act, District Narmadapuram whereby appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Section 376(DA) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with the fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulations.
I.A. No.15720 of 2023 i.e. the first application of the appellant for suspension of remaining jail sentence was dismissed on merits vide order dated 01.11.2023 on omnibus and general allegations.

It was submitted that DNA of the two accused persons Khemchand Yadav and Pooran Yadav matched and therefore, appellant prayed for suspension of sentence but it was rejected by the Coordinate bench saying that in case of a gang rape DNA evidence is not a very reliable evidence.
However, it is submitted that prosecutrix had lodged report against Rahul and three other unknown accused persons.

It is submitted that the identification 2 CRA-12290-2022 parade was vitiated on account of it being carried out in Tehsil office as is admitted by both Prosecutrix PW1 and the Revenue Inspector who had carried out the TIP in Tehsil office.
Therefore, identification made in the Tehsil office is of no evidentiary value.
There are good chances of success in the appeal.
Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Government Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant - Shera @ Umashankar Mehtar and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees thirty thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 06.10.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant - Shera @ Umashankar Mehtar shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
